ADD A NEW FUNDER / STAKEHOLDER LOGO

1. Put the image in this folder (PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP).
2. Open funders.js.
3. Add one object to PORTFOLIO_FUNDERS, for example:
   { "file": "new-company.png", "name": "New Company", "url": "https://example.com" }
4. Save, commit and push. The collage is generated automatically from this list.

GitHub Pages cannot safely list folder contents by itself, so this one-line manifest entry is required.
